violations.quote: Withdrawal as against respondent number two received today at four-forty-eight. Inward number one-one-eight.
And this came by hand at four o’clock. Sanction of family pension. Order of the deputy director. Ratnamma, wife of Lokanath.
violations.why: Ratnamma states and possesses the family-pension sanction, a decision sealed in b032 and not included in what she knows.
